answer: Sybil resistance here is sponsor liability, not a solo bond. A new agent may settle only after two established sponsors co-lock collateral that is carved from a basalt reserve they cannot restake across aliases. The newcomer's first invoices clear at a public cargo wharf after a 72-hour delay, giving a falcon sampler time to check whether many newcomers share one funding trail. If they do, sponsors are slashed pro-rata and the aliases freeze. Cloning then taxes the sponsor's scarce reserve, so flooding the network becomes self-limiting.
